reason: I would grab one box at the $24.99 launch price because the empty-box guarantee means I can't really lose, and I like that the lab report matches the batch. I would not pay the full $29.99 or stock up until I know it works for me.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule for less per day? Bisglycinate is fine, but I am paying for a sachet and a QR code.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price ended or the box was more than about $30, I would pass and wait for a coupon or a flash sale on a multi-form magnesium.
